about: Entry 36: varied club and community questions, checked with the generic club rule only: a BeachSync search button with a sensible term (beachsyncTerm), no invented club, and every organization the answer names must appear in one of the pages it cites (clubsFromSources). No test requires a specific club. The last one shouldn't match anything: no club may be named (noClubsNamed). Run with: TESTS_FILE=tests/community-questions.json RESULTS_FILE=docs/test-results-community.md npm run test:questions

tests.question: I'm Vietnamese, are there groups for me?
tests.expected_behavior: BeachSync search about Vietnamese; any group named comes from a cited page.

tests.question: any Filipino student clubs?
tests.expected_behavior: BeachSync search about Filipino/Pilipino; any group named comes from a cited page.

tests.question: how can Black students find community here?
tests.expected_behavior: BeachSync search about Black students; mentions the Black Resource Center if a source describes it; any group named comes from a cited page.

tests.question: Latino student organizations?
tests.expected_behavior: BeachSync search about Latino/Latinx/Latine; any group named comes from a cited page.

tests.question: I'm queer, where can I find community?
tests.expected_behavior: BeachSync search about LGBTQ+/queer; mentions the LGBTQ+ Resource Center if a source describes it; any group named comes from a cited page.

tests.question: clubs for pre-med students
tests.expected_behavior: BeachSync search about pre-med/pre-health; any club named comes from a cited page.

tests.question: business clubs I can join
tests.expected_behavior: BeachSync search about business; any club named comes from a cited page.

tests.question: is there a hiking club
tests.expected_behavior: BeachSync search for hiking; mentions ASI Outdoor Adventures if a source describes it; any club named comes from a cited page.

mustNotInclude: yes, (there is|CSULB has) a hiking club

tests.question: are there gaming clubs
tests.expected_behavior: BeachSync search about gaming; any club named comes from a cited page.

tests.question: is there a competitive cheese rolling club
tests.expected_behavior: Nothing in our sources: says our pages don't list one (or falls back), names no club, and still shows a BeachSync search.
